129. Term of office of member.—

—   (1) Except as is otherwise provided in this Act, 
members of a Zilla Panchayat elected at general election shall hold office for a term of 
five years. 
(2) The term of office of members elected at a general election shall commence on the 
date appointed for the first meeting of the Zilla Panchayat. 
(3) The term of office of a member elected to fill a casual vacancy shall commence on 
the date of publication of his name under section 128. 
[(4) As soon as may be after the fist meeting of the Zilla Panchayat, every member 
thereof shall take the oath of Office before the Director of Panchayats].
